assert not os.path.lexists(packet) and not os.path.lexists('/workspace/vm-c5-c1-pre-24cf-r03-01') and not os.path.lexists('/workspace/vm-c5-run-24cf-r03')
r=json.loads((e/'native-page-response.json').read_bytes());b=r['structuredContent']['text'].encode('ascii')
assert len(b)==30845 and sha(b)=='c213beaa39e3596b269c590cb650ffd0c0a1c8b073e9c5b7c804e2a8b112f4e8' and b.count(b'\\n')==1 and b.endswith(b'\\n') and b'\\r' not in b
z=base64.b64decode(b[:-1],validate=True);assert len(z)==23133 and sha(z)=='1f1522a62dcaf93e51c5a9390559e27931f4d47fe333fc9ea99e2aefb4d192ab'
a=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(z));infos=a.infolist();names=[i.filename for i in infos]
assert len(infos)==len(set(names))==len({n.casefold() for n in names})==7 and sum(i.file_size for i in infos)==76328

 q=pathlib.PurePosixPath(i.filename)
 assert not q.is_absolute() and not i.is_dir() and all(x not in ('','..','.') for x in i.filename.split('/')) and '\\\\' not in i.filename and ':' not in i.filename and '\\x00' not in i.filename
 assert not stat.S_ISLNK(i.external_attr>>16) and not i.external_attr&0x400 and not i.flag_bits&1
data={i.filename:a.read(i) for i in infos}
sealbytes=data['SOURCE.SHA256.json'];assert len(sealbytes)==769 and sha(sealbytes)=='2345d41939c978a165693f4417db6944fe983fad42706466f6f986bf617d739e'
seal=json.loads(sealbytes);assert len(seal)==6 and set(seal)==set(names)-{'SOURCE.SHA256.json'}
for name,pin in seal.items():assert len(data[name])==pin['bytes'] and sha(data[name])==pin['sha256']
for name,pin in {'fixture.py':{'bytes':20601,'sha256':'a3425095abc2dd6fc444cff848053396424202aa019636fc87685889e3ccb208'},'manifest.json':{'bytes':12565,'sha256':'15e10b1038f2ced4787e73cca5a19039132cf54b432191e3347aa394e3742b4a'},'frozen/runner.py':{'bytes':29404,'sha256':'f7b4206ac2b96dcfc0d0f59560bcf83c5f0757684e1b8d17355518516d906343'}}.items():assert seal[name]==pin
assert data['frozen/runner.py']==(source/'packet/runner.py').read_bytes()
manifest=json.loads(data['manifest.json']);expected=json.loads(data['EXTRACTIONS.json'])
assert manifest['schema']=='vm-c1-non-product-preparation-r03-01' and len(manifest['required_cases'])==len({x['name'] for x in manifest['required_cases']})==14
candidateBindings=[]
for name,pin in manifest['frozen_candidate_files_preserved'].items():
 p=source/'transport.zip' if name=='transport.zip' else source/'packet'/name
 raw=p.read_bytes();assert len(raw)==pin['bytes'] and sha(raw)==pin['sha256']
 candidateBindings.append({'path':str(p),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha(raw),'matches':True})
tree=ast.parse(data['frozen/runner.py']);functions={n.name:n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
child=functions['child'];parent=functions['supervise'];handler=next(n for n in functions['main'].body if isinstance(n,ast.Try)).handlers[0]
segments={};body=[]
for name in ('utc','save','effect_denial_counts','observe_effect_denials','residual_files'):
 segments[name]=[functions[name]];body.append(copy.deepcopy(functions[name]))
def wrapper(name,parameters,nodes,tail=None):
 nodes=list(nodes);segments[name]=nodes;copied=copy.deepcopy(nodes)
 if tail:
  extra=ast.parse(tail).body[0];ast.increment_lineno(extra,max(n.end_lineno for n in nodes));copied.append(extra)
 function=ast.parse('def '+name+'('+parameters+'):\\n    pass\\n').body[0]
 function.body=copied;function.lineno=min(n.lineno for n in nodes);function.end_lineno=max(n.end_lineno for n in copied);body.append(function)
wrapper('guard_factory','root, args, tmp',child.body[5:10],'return denial_state, denial_stream, audit')
wrapper('finish_synthetic','root, args, denial_state, denial_stream, ids, result, started, before',child.body[31:43])
wrapper('parent_acceptance','root, manifest, process, terminal, timed_out, code, before, after, started, kill_error',list(parent.body[12:25])+[parent.body[26]])
wrapper('capture_child_error','args, text',handler.body[2:4])
catalog={name:{'lines':[[n.lineno,n.end_lineno] for n in nodes],'ast_sha256':sha(ast.dump(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),include_attributes=False).encode())} for name,nodes in segments.items()}
selected=ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=body,type_ignores=[]));catalog['_selected_module']={'ast_sha256':sha(ast.dump(selected,include_attributes=False).encode())}
assert catalog==expected and json.loads(data['SOURCE-CHECKS.json'])['extracted_catalog']==expected
def save(p,b):
 fd=os.open(p,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(b)
save(e/'fixture-carrier.base64.txt',b);save(e/'fixture-transport.zip',z)
packet.mkdir(mode=0o700)
for name,raw in data.items():
 current=packet
 for part in pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).parts[:-1]:
  current=current/part
  if not current.exists():current.mkdir(mode=0o700)
  assert not current.is_symlink()
 save(packet/name,raw)
rows=[]
for name in sorted(names):
 raw=(packet/name).read_bytes();assert raw==data[name];rows.append({'path':name,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha(raw)})
out={'scope':'C1_FIXTURE_SOURCE_MATERIALIZATION_AST_BINDING_ONLY','utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'fixturePacket':str(packet),'fixture7Pins':rows,'sourceFiles':7,'sourceBytes':76328,'carrier':{'bytes':len(b),'sha256':sha(b)},'ZIP':{'bytes':len(z),'sha256':sha(z)},'all6SealPinsVerified':True,'safeZIPChecks':True,'frozenRunnerMatchesCurrentCandidateBytes':True,'candidate12Bindings':candidateBindings,'EXTRACTIONSActualCatalog':catalog,'EXTRACTIONSBindingsMatch':True,'ASTOnlyNoSelectedDefinitionsExecuted':True,'requiredCaseNames':[x['name'] for x in manifest['required_cases']],'fixtureInvocations':0,'productImportsLoadersTests':0,'dummyRunCreated':False,'futureProductRunCreated':False,'nativeCommandId':None,'providerNativeId':None}
